name: Caste Certificate
summary: Official proof that an individual belongs to a Scheduled Caste (SC), Scheduled Tribe (ST), or Other Backward Class (OBC) community, used for reservation in education, jobs, and welfare schemes.
eligibility: Applicant's community must appear on the state government's recognised SC/ST/OBC list
For minors, a parent or guardian can apply on the child's behalf
documents: Ration card or proof of residence
fee: Usually free or a nominal charge, depending on the state
process: Apply through your state's e-District/revenue department portal, or in person at the Tehsil/SDM office
Submit identity, residence, and paternal caste-proof documents
Application is verified, sometimes with a field enquiry by a revenue official
Certificate is issued digitally or physically

faq.question: How long is a caste certificate valid?
faq.answer: SC/ST certificates are typically permanent, issued once for life. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificates are usually income-linked and must be renewed annually or every few years, depending on the state and the purpose.

faq.question: Is this issued by the central government?
faq.answer: No — like income certificates, caste certificates are issued by state revenue departments, so the exact portal and process depend on your state.

stateVariants.processingTime: Up to 21 working days, may involve a field enquiry by the Talathi/Tehsildar
stateVariants.validity: SC/ST: lifelong. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer): typically 1 year
stateVariants.notes: Apply under Revenue Department services; a Caste Validity Certificate from the Caste Scrutiny Committee may additionally be required for admissions/jobs.
The signed self-declaration/verification form generally must also be sent to the concerned SDM office after online submission.
Register with a mobile number on the e-Sathi citizen portal before applying.

stateVariants.processingTime: 7-21 working days, pending Village Accountant and Tahsildar verification
stateVariants.notes: Requires Aadhaar eSign; download the digitally signed certificate using the RD number once approved.
